summary: The top SOCRadar Attack Surface Management Ultimate edition: external attack surface with active scanning, API, integrations and the OnWatch service.
value: It shows everything the company exposes and where it is vulnerable.
Findings flow into your controls via API.
simple: Continuously searches the internet for everything the company owns: domains, websites, IP addresses, services, cloud storage, code repositories — and keeps an inventory of these assets with an attack surface map. Finds misconfigurations in email, DNS, SSL certificates, websites and cloud, information leaks and open ports; passively checks for vulnerabilities and prioritizes risks. Daily scans, plus mobile application analysis and active external vulnerability scanning: checks against the CISA KEV catalog (vulnerabilities already being exploited) and for vulnerabilities used by ransomware, and in-depth ASTA assessment (cloud, network, email, websites, APIs, databases, DNS). User roles, audit log and SSO. Also has an API and integrations and the OnWatch service; volumes are licensed flexibly to fit the company’s needs.
classification: Active vulnerability scanning is external only, not vulnerability management.
